result.summary: Found 1 critical layout issue: the bottom tab bar is clipped and obscured by a thick black bar, blocking navigation.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is visually broken: icons are clipped at the bottom edge and obscured by a thick black horizontal bar crossing over the search and saved icons
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom safe-area padding so tab bar sits above system home indicator, and fix home indicator rendering to normal thin style so navigation icons are fully visible and tappable
